text:
kevin-sales: Heads up — just finished scoping with MercuryBank. They want a 12mo commit, blended per-token across gen+embeddings, monthly rollover of unused credits, multi-region (NA+EU), overage cap at 20% of committed spend, and a custom SLA. Need a product recommendation for the deal this week.

josh-product: Thanks. Can you paste their expected monthly token estimates + rough QPS? even coarse numbers help.

kevin-sales: They gave: ~1.2B gen tokens/month, ~300M embedding tokens/month. Target initial commit ~$250k/month. Latency SLO: 95th pct EU <150ms. Contact: emma@mercury.

alex-support: Noted. Rollover is a new billing pattern for us — it requires tracking per-customer unused credits and reconciling monthly. Overages today are typically charged at 1.5x list for burst.

meera-pricing: Drafting three options quickly:
- Option A: Standard Reserved (no rollover) + overage at 1.5x. Fastest to deliver.
- Option B: Committed + monthly rollover (cap) + tiered per-token discounts. Medium effort.
- Option C: Hybrid with a shared burst pool + limited rollover and strict overage cap. More complex but matches their ask.

meera-pricing: Example sketch (Option B):
- commit: $250k/mo (12mo)
- price: $0.70 per 1k gen tokens, $0.15 per 1k embed tokens
- rollover: up to 25% of committed tokens can carry month->month
- overage cap: 20% of commit at 1.25x price
- note: requires billing pipeline + legal addenda

sara-ops: Ops impact: implementing rollover requires per-customer token ledger, billing reconciliation changes, and UI for customer usage/rollover visibility. Estimate ~2w dev + 1w QA for a gated MVP if we reuse existing metering. Multi-region routing SLA adds infra work.

finance-bot: Quick model: 12mo commit $250k/mo => $3M ARR. Cost floor assumptions give ~40% gross margin at prices above. Will run a sensitivity for rollover utilization.

josh-product: Proposed launch criteria for any pilot: 1) metering + billing supports rollover or explicit pilot terms 2) legal-approved SLA + addendum 3) P&L signoff from finance 4) operational playbook for failover to fallback models. If any criteria fail, we offer a reduced-scope pilot.

kevin-sales: Mercury needs a yes/no by Fri. Can we scope a 3mo pilot (commit) without rollover to move faster?

meera-pricing: Pilot option: 3mo commit at the per-token price above, no rollover, 10% onboarding credit. If pilot meets usage targets, enable rollover in the 12mo renewal with the capped carryover. This reduces billing work for initial go-live.

alex-support: :thumbsup: I'll estimate exact engineering tickets. Tentative effort: billing changes for full rollover = 3 dev-sprints, but pilot (no-rollover) is just legal + SLA + routing config.

josh-product: Owners: josh-product -> product spec + rollout plan; sara-ops -> billing design & implementation estimate; meera-pricing -> final pricing language & legal checklist; finance-bot -> run P&L sensitivity.

josh-product: Scheduling 30m sync tomorrow 10:00 PT with Sales, Ops, Pricing. @kevin-sales please add Mercury attendees. Agenda: numbers, scope tradeoffs, go/no-go criteria.

kevin-sales: Added emma@mercury and their procurement lead. Thanks — will prepare their detailed usage export.

meera-pricing: I'll draft three-line commercial terms and a short playbook for the pilot by EOD.

alex-support: Will post an initial ops estimate before the sync.

finance-bot: I'll upload baseline P&L scenarios to the shared drive and tag this thread.

josh-product: Great. If anyone surfaces major blockers ahead of the meeting call them out here. Otherwise see you tomorrow. :rocket:
